about_the_game:
You are the gorilla.
They are the 100 men.
Only one side walks away.

The Showdown: Gorilla vs. 100 is a chaotic, over-the-top roguelike/roguelite brawler where you take on wave after wave of determined (but mostly doomed) human opponents. With physics-driven ragdoll mayhem, every punch, throw, and slam is uniquely hilarious and brutally satisfying.

🧠 Why fight 100 men?

Because the internet won't stop arguing about it.
Because science won't answer the question.
Because you're a gorilla—and gorillas don't need a reason.

💥 Features:

  • 100 men. No mercy. Face a growing variety of challenges.

  • Brutal ragdoll physics. Every hit is a spectacle thanks to dynamic animations and weighty combat.

  • Roguelike progression. Every run is different—unlock gorilla upgrades, new abilities, and arena modifiers.

  • Skill meets silliness. Easy to pick up, hard to master, and always hilarious to watch.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains cartoon-style violence as the main character, a gorilla, engages in melee combat with various enemies. Players will encounter:

Hand-to-hand combat with punching, grabbing, and throwing mechanics
Enemies being knocked down or ragdolling upon defeat
Impact effects and non-graphic hit indicators
Boss fights with more intense combat sequences

While the violence is stylized rather than realistic, players will be fighting waves of enemies throughout the game. There are no depictions of blood, gore, dismemberment, or extreme violence. The game does not contain any sexual content, drug/alcohol references, or depictions of self-harm. The content is appropriate for teenage and adult players who are comfortable with action combat games.

short_description: A physics-based roguelike brawler where you play as a gorilla smashing your way through 100 men. Punch, throw, and ragdoll your enemies in chaotic, ever-changing game. Easy to pick up, wild to watch, and built to settle the internet’s dumbest debate.
